paragraphs: R. Chizkiyah learned Torah mysteries from a child: Zohar, Bereshit, locator ער״ז. R. Chiyya and R. Chizkiyah—Elijah told them that Jerusalem would be destroyed: there, Vayetze, locator עשנ״ב, with R. Yosi and R. Yudah; see there. And R. Elazar: Zohar, Shemot, locator עק״כ.
